headword: {急|せ}いては{事|こと}を{仕損|しそん}じる
reading: せいてはことをしそんじる
gloss: haste makes waste; more haste, less speed

definitions.gloss: haste makes waste; rushing leads to mistakes
definitions.explanation: A proverb warning that acting too hastily causes errors and poor results. Patience and careful action produce better outcomes.

examples.japanese: {急|せ}いては{事|こと}を{仕損|しそん}じる⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
{急|せ}いては{事|こと}を{仕損|しそん}じる⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけよう→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: They say haste makes waste, so let's take a little more time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焦|あせ}って→焦る：04619_aseru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}したら→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。{急|せ}いては{事|こと}を{仕損|しそん}じる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ことだ。
examples.english: I rushed to get ready and forgot something. This is exactly what they mean by haste makes waste.

notes:
A common Japanese proverb equivalent to the English "haste makes waste" or "more haste, less speed." The verb ⟦{仕損|しそん}じる→仕損じる：17194_shisonjiru⟧ means "to fail" or "to bungle," so the literal meaning is "if you rush, you will bungle the task."

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ⟦{急|せ}いて→急く：30154_seku⟧ is the te-form of ⟦{急|せ}く→急く：30154_seku⟧ (to hurry), and ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ adds contrastive emphasis: "if you hurry (in contrast to being patient), you will fail." The proverb is typically quoted in its full form.

SIMILAR PROVERBS:
- ⟦{急|いそ}がば{回|まわ}れ→急がば回れ：06337_isogabamaware⟧: if in a hurry, take the roundabout way — similar meaning emphasizing careful action
- ⟦{慌|あわ}てる→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧{乞食|こじき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もらい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: the beggar who panics gets less — similar admonition against rushing

USAGE:
Often used as gentle advice or self-reflection when someone has made a mistake due to rushing. Commonly followed by ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧, ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ことだ, or だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧.
